description: This file contains server-side functions for fetching and processing team and event data, including caching, enrichment, and CRM integration, used within a Next.js application.

methods.name: getCachedTeamData
methods.description: Fetches team data with caching based on teamSlug and orgSlug.

methods.name: getCachedTeamEventType
methods.description: Fetches team event type data with caching based on teamSlug, meetingSlug, and orgSlug.

methods.name: getEnrichedEventType
methods.description: Enriches event type data with additional context such as owner, hosts, users, and metadata.

methods.name: shouldUseApiV2ForTeamSlots
methods.description: Determines if API v2 should be used for team slots based on feature flags and environment variables.

methods.name: getCRMData
methods.description: Retrieves CRM-related data from query parameters, performing lookup if necessary.

methods.name: getTeamId
methods.description: Fetches the team ID based on teamSlug and optional orgSlug.
